exposure: preconceptional weight loss therapy (lifestyle/dietary intervention and liraglutide)
outcome: peripheral sensory nerve function (vibration sense, current perception threshold)
metabolic parameters (blood pressure, blood cell counts, glucose metabolism markers, kidney/liver function, lipid profile)
cohort: The study included infertile women with obesity undergoing preconceptional weight optimization before IVF and age-matched controls with normal BMI.
finding: Infertile women with obesity exhibited peripheral sensory neuronal impairments and cardiovascular autonomic dysfunction compared to controls; preconceptional weight loss improved metabolic parameters and resulted in successful pregnancies (spontaneous or via IVF) for a significant portion of the cohort.
